areas.evidence: The owned NONMATCHING draft compiles. make -j1 compare prints shiningsoul2_eu.gba: OK with the original ASM fallback; make -j1 nonmatching exits 0; check_tree reports 0 errors. No equivalent-C claim is made.

areas.label: Original 588-byte local frame
areas.evidence: The original frame is 0x24C bytes. Compiler RTL showed two extra spill slots at SP+588 and SP+592 caused by the next-effect pointer and field-address hoisting. Separate temporary bases at sub_08065370 prevent retaining field addresses across state branches. The module candidate now allocates exactly 588 bytes, matching the original frame; complete code still differs.

areas.label: Effect record and configuration initialization
areas.evidence: The draft scans input record kinds 8/9 at stride 0x124, initializes effect records at runtime+0x58C, and uses position/active tables at +0x160/+0x22C. A single canonical global-pointer view and an explicit gUnk_084B186C configuration-tail alias reduce avoidable CSE differences. Exact register/literal-pool order remains unresolved.

areas.evidence: The draft retains state cases 0/10/11/12, sprite helper calls, packet/item handling and display/hide calls. The original uses a bottom-tested effect-count loop and pointer roles r7=current, r9=next, sl=state global address. Candidate pointer allocation, helper argument order and CFG still differ; no semantic equivalence is inferred from compilation.
